explanation: The text lists 'HER2+ maintenance combination' as a current FDA-approved indication. All evidence shown states IBRANCE (palbociclib) is approved only for HR+/HER2-NEGATIVE disease (AI, fulvestrant, or inavolisib+fulvestrant). No evidence supports a HER2+ indication; this appears to contradict the cited labeling.
suggested_rewrite: Remove 'HER2+ maintenance combination.' On-label discussion should be limited to HR+/HER2-negative advanced/metastatic breast cancer: AI combination, fulvestrant combination, or inavolisib+fulvestrant for PIK3CA-mutated disease, per current Prescribing Information.
